scope: Independent read-only correctness review of process-isolated warm OCR candidate; local images/processes only
candidate_source_state: Frozen committed candidate4199344, with exact source-exact release artifact and file hashes. No product changes made by reviewer.

resolved_findings.issue: A retained worker that exits after idle could be used once more and permanently disable warm OCR on EPIPE/EOF.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent retires after55s, checks/reaps an exited child before dispatch, and can initialize a new worker. Drop does not signal an already-reaped PID.
resolved_findings.validation: Source verified; independent private-model replacement and missing-language recovery prove retirement/rewarm paths. Final backend receipt separately qualifies actual61.5s idle PID removal and rewarm.

resolved_findings.issue: The first idle-timeout patch used transfer on blocking child stdin, so its read could block past the deadline.
resolved_findings.resolution: Child sets its own stdin read descriptor O_NONBLOCK before API startup and before bounded header/body reads.
resolved_findings.validation: Independently inspected actual live worker fdinfo flags for O_NONBLOCK; backend separately reported real idle and partial-header timeout integration.

resolved_findings.issue: An unknown failure after dispatch could silently run CLI recognition again and under-report work or double a timeout budget.
resolved_findings.resolution: Post-dispatch crash/protocol failure now returns ocr_failed for that request, retires the worker and disables warm mode for future calls. Known pre-recognition unsupported inputs/models may still fall back; cancellation/timeout/output-limit errors are preserved.
resolved_findings.validation: Independently confirmed90framed bytes queued in an owned stopped worker before SIGKILL. Current request failed; only the next explicit request used CLI and succeeded.

resolved_findings.issue: Linux PDEATHSIG follows the creating thread; a worker spawned in a short-lived MCP request thread died when that request returned.
resolved_findings.resolution: One persistent process-owner thread creates workers through a capacity1 channel. Spawned RAII stops/reaps abandoned handoffs; receiver waits remain bounded and cancellable. No foreign OCR code runs in that thread.
resolved_findings.validation: Independently observed the same owned worker PID across fresh Alpha/Omega images in real persistent MCP.150 abandoned handoffs exercised separately with no child or fd leak.

resolved_findings.issue: Automatic OMP_THREAD_LIMIT1 initially overrode the effect of an explicitly supplied OMP_NUM_THREADS.
resolved_findings.resolution: Either explicit OMP setting suppresses the automatic limit; both values belong to the model key.
resolved_findings.validation: Independent live worker environment preserved OMP_NUM_THREADS2 without injecting a limit; a custom executable preserved OMP_NUM_THREADS3 and was called once.

resolved_findings.issue: A live MCP whose executable pathname was unlinked could no longer create the same private worker protocol through current_exe().
resolved_findings.resolution: On Linux, host_executable selects /proc/self/exe when available, retaining the running image inode; portable current_exe fallback remains.
resolved_findings.validation: Independent before/after unlink probe: b075 read succeeded only throughCLI with no warm child. Final1e000 release created a worker after unlink; after that worker was killed before dispatch, the next fresh read recreated a new worker and succeeded. Shutdown reaped both owned worker PIDs.

resolved_findings.issue: A child that self-exited while an idle MCP received no later OCR call could remain unreaped in the pool until shutdown.
resolved_findings.resolution: The existing owner uses recv_timeout1s and pool.try_lock to retire/reap idle or exited workers. It never blocks on the pool lock held by a caller waiting for a spawn reply; no extra thread or process-wide SIGCHLD reaper.
resolved_findings.validation: Independent exact-loop facade test held PoolMutex across owner timeout and still completed owned_spawn; an aged actual owned child was removed/reaped without another request. Final backend integration separately exercised the real61.5s timer and checked PID removal, not just zombie state.

source_review.checks: MCP enables only the Rust parent machinery; the private _ocr_engine entry executes native-library code only in a separate process. Normal host code does not call C ABI functions.

C ABI signatures checked against installed tesseract/capi.h and leptonica/allheaders.h. Dynamic library handles outlive engine/function pointers; engine/Pix/text/monitor cleanup paths are balanced. Leptonica symbols resolve through Tesseract dependency handle. CLI/CAPI exact5.x version agreement required.

Standard executable eligibility uses fixed system path, regular/non-group-or-world-writable ELF with lib5 dependency marker, and startup version comparison. Explicit/custom TOMACCO_TESSERACT and PATH wrappers bypass the worker; no global environment mutation.

Pool key covers language, TESSDATA_PREFIX, explicit OpenMP settings, binary inode/size/mtime/mode and candidate traineddata metadata. Each native read gets frozen image pixels; API Clear and ClearAdaptiveClassifier run before recognition.

Spawned RAII owns Child until successful take. SendError, queued reply destruction and cancellation after receive all trigger stop/reap. One owner thread/capacity1 job queue, reply capacity1, polling cancellation/deadline waits.

Pool try_lock avoids queuing unrelated OCR; at most one retained native worker and one in-flight framed request. Init/model unavailability selects CLI before recognition; unknown post-dispatch errors fail explicitly. Cache/adaptive pass selection remains in existing screen_ocr code.

Framed requests<=16KiB, replies<=8MiB, startup reply<=4096bytes, parent pipe reads/writes nonblocking, partial transfers preserve offsets and inspect cancellation/deadline/RSS; closed/error descriptors terminate rather than busy-loop.

Child address-space cap512MiB; parent RSS threshold256MiB,128read retirement,55s parent retirement/60s child idle deadline. Warm image cap9,000,000pixels selects CLI above that bound; public visual decode limit64*1024*1024 remains unchanged.

Owner idle timeout takes Pool only with try_lock, preserving lock ordering while Worker::start holds the guard awaiting owner delivery. Worker Drop waits only its owned process. All idle/abandonment cleanup avoids a global reaper and does not consume unrelated child statuses.

nonblocking_observations.note: shutdown retires the pool before try_send(Stop), but does not join the owner thread; a full job queue can drop Stop. PDEATHSIG still protects process exit and RAII protects abandoned handoffs. No surviving-child repro found; normal actual MCP shutdown and150 abandoned handoffs completed cleanly.

limitations: No hardware, device discovery, installed state, Bogen or UI changes.
Only the listed local fixtures/configurations were executed; no all-language OCR accuracy claim.
9.9MP public fallback was executed; the unchanged64Mi-pixel public limit was source-reviewed, not an actual64Mi-pixel recognition run.
RSS/address-space/counter limits were source-reviewed; reviewer did not force an OOM,128-read recycle, signal storm, or actual90s recognition timeout.
Exact byte-level output parity covers TSV rows for the generated Alpha/Omega cases, not arbitrary OCR documents.
Existing image-result cache assumes stable recognizer configuration for identical cached pixels; worker keys do not change that preexisting cache contract.
No performance, FPS, hardware speedup, competitor, or general cancellation-latency claim.
